name: core-intl
title: Core: rupees and the Indian clock
description: Money and time the way Goa writes them, as pure functions that give the same answer on any machine. rupees(125000) is ₹1,25,000 (lakh and crore grouping done by hand, so no engine or ICU build can change it), with paise when asked and a clean minus sign; formatMoney() does other currencies too. Times and dates read in Asia/Kolkata whatever zone the visitor's phone or the build server is in: istDay() is the IST calendar day of an instant, clock() says 11 pm, clock24() 23:00, formatWhen() 'Sun 4 Oct, 11 am to 1 pm', relativeDay() 'today' or 'tomorrow' counted in IST calendar days. Nothing reads the clock; the caller passes now, so tests can fake it. No Temporal yet.

budget.reason: Decision 0010: a pure core, counted apart at its own 12 KB. It replaces four hand-rolled copies (data-table, menu, event-card, room-details) and is shared by wa-order. Today 10.6 KB with comments.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
